# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native mobile-first portrait game called **Moonseed Grove: Spirit Errand**. Preserve a top-down free-roam canvas loop: the player moves with a left joystick or WASD/arrows, gathers nearby collectibles with one action, holds one collected charm at a time, uses a second action to project a forward calming arc, defeats chasing spirits for +100 score, loses one of three hearts on contact, and restarts after game over. Maintain item rarity, held-item attack stats, enemy spawn caps, score-driven pressure, collection persistence, and active HUD updates.

Reinterpret the loop as a Studio-Ghibli-inspired fantasy exploration through painterly nature. The focal actor is a childlike leaf-capped grove guide. Collectibles are handmade memory charms. Chasing hazards are lonely soot-paper spirits. Score is restored glow; hearts are heart-leaves; attack is a gentle hum. Use procedural Canvas scenery: layered soft hills, moss circles, lantern houses, floating islands, pollen, warm paper textures, and handmade UI cards. Optimize for portrait aspect ratios from 4:7 to 9:16 with large touch buttons, readable HUD, and non-blocking overlays.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
The original game is a self-contained canvas free-roam action/exploration game. The player moves through a large 2500x2500 world with a mobile joystick or keyboard, gathers nearby relics with a grab button, holds one relic/tool at a time, attacks in a forward arc, defeats chasing enemies for score, loses one of three hearts on contact, and enters game over at zero hearts. A persistent collection index records discovered item IDs.

## Protected Mechanics
- Free-roam top-down movement with acceleration, friction, world bounds, and camera follow.
- Left-thumb joystick plus keyboard movement; action buttons remain gather/grab and attack/hum.
- Circular pickup detection, one held item, held item modifies damage/reach/cooldown/knockback.
- Enemy spawning at world edges, enemy chase motion, contact damage with invulnerability.
- Forward arc attack collision, enemy defeat, +100 score per defeated enemy, chance to drop a relic.
- Three-heart fail state, game-over modal, restart and menu flows.
- Collection index and localStorage persistence.

## Remixed Target
Moonseed Grove: Spirit Errand reframes the same loop as a gentle painterly fantasy exploration. The player is a leaf-capped child guide collecting memory charms and soothing soot-paper spirits in a handmade grove.

## Safe Presentation Transformations
The haunted carnival title, neon palette, checkerboard mansion scenery, ghost paperwork language, gag relic names, button labels, fonts, menu panels, particles, and canvas silhouettes were safe to replace because they are not mechanic-critical.

## Runtime Surface
`index_old.html` is preserved as the legacy reference. The canonical new public surface is `index.html`, with inline CSS and JavaScript.
